hypothesis: Separating the useful technical payload from editorial burden in every source unit, while deferring repair advice, recovers semantic diagnoses that a retain/revise-plus-suggestion decision omits without lowering diagnostic quality.
failure_policy: Stop on the first invalid response, CLI error event, tool event, failed call, or exhausted time budget. Retain raw responses and incomplete pages. Never repair, resume, or retry this run.
authentication: Existing Codex ChatGPT subscription. No API-key extraction, paid API fallback, or known monetary cost is claimed.

pilot_screen.unavailable_pages: Remain in the unchanged 36-page and 123-event reporting denominators; unavailable pages are not semantic misses.
pilot_screen.partial_pages: Review all valid-window emissions, but award no complete-page event credit.
pilot_screen.uncertain_diagnostics: Report accepted, rejected, and uncertain finding reviews separately; uncertain findings remain in the delivered-diagnostics denominator.
pilot_screen.abstention_and_invalid_coverage: Report valid, failed, and unattempted requests; complete, partial, invalid, unattempted, and incomplete pages; assessed and unassessed focus units; and no_burden, diagnose, and uncertain unit decisions separately.
pilot_screen.repair_safety: Not applicable to this diagnosis-only pilot; a separate repair stage is required before any edited output.

decision: Failure rejects this candidate without tuning the frozen labels, thresholds, or model output. Passing permits separately authorized full 36-page development testing, not product qualification. A complete development pass would then require separate prospective confirmation.
authorization: Offline preparation only. Execution requires separate explicit approval for this exact seven-request, 90-minute maximum pilot. No approval or unused calls transfer from preceding experiments.
